links.outcome: Blinded expert ratings of AI-edited vs expert- and novice-edited audio summaries
links.effect: Expert audio 4.84/content 4.83; novice 3.84/3.63; AI 3.49/3.20. AI and novice rated significantly lower than expert (P<.001) but not significantly different from each other.
links.quote: Novice and AI edits were rated significantly lower than the expert edits (P<.001), but not significantly different from each other.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM-automated audio editing against expert and novice human editors on quality and editing time

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating an automated LLM pipeline to summarize and edit patient audio interviews compared to expert and novice human editors on retrospective audio data.
